title: Contrix Event
description: Single canonical wire object. Reducer-input events carry top-level preconditions / effects / anchor_ref. Non-reducer events (read marker, typing, etc.) omit those three fields. Causal refs use prev_refs (actor chain) and refs[] (semantic refs with role: authorized_by, attestation, parent_event, after, recovery_capability, state_witness, inclusion_proof, ...). Signing covers canonical bytes minus proofs and unsigned; hlc IS included in canonical bytes (signed and integrity-protected) but is semantically advisory — see encoding.md §7.

kind.description: Standard cx.* effect kinds MUST appear in artifacts/registry/event-kind-registry.json. State convergence is defined by event preconditions/effects, Anchor DAG finality, and per-cell Lattice join.

hlc.description: Advisory hybrid logical clock. INCLUDED in canonical bytes for signing and event digest (so it is integrity-protected and cannot be rewritten by relays), but semantically advisory: used only as a deterministic tiebreaker for timeline display when two events are causally unreachable. MUST NOT influence authorization, lattice join, Move precondition comparison, or anchor finality. See encoding.md §7 and event-auth-state-resolution.md §3 rule 1.

prev_refs.description: Actor-chain causal predecessors (envelope-level). For semantic refs (authorized_by, after, state_witness, inclusion_proof, ...), use refs[].

refs.description: Semantic refs with role. Roles include: authorized_by (replaces v1's auth_refs[]), attestation, parent_event, after, audit_pair, recovery_capability, state_witness, inclusion_proof. audit_pair links a privacy-sensitive business event to its cx.audit.accessed record in the same Anchor batch; state_witness/inclusion_proof are critical for conflict-recovery events; see event-auth-state-resolution.md §8.1.

preconditions.description: Reducer-input only. Pre-state predicates that must hold under the anchor_ref view; if any fails, the entire event fails (no partial application of effects).

effects.description: Reducer-input only. Atomic multi-cell CAS writes. MUST contain at least one effect when present.

anchor_ref.description: Reducer-input only. Anchor DAG node this event is submitted against. Receivers MUST verify it is within the Realm's max_anchor_staleness_ms window.

unsigned.description: Local / transport-only metadata (server-derived hints, redaction reason, age). NOT covered by signature or event digest.

proofs.description: Detached signatures over canonical event bytes (excluding only proofs and unsigned; hlc IS covered as advisory metadata — see hlc field description). The actor / device / service signature lives here. Anchor signatures live on the Anchor object, not on the event.

requirements.description: Schema/reducer/feature/critical-extension requirements declared by this event. All sub-fields enter the canonical event bytes and the proof payload_hash. Receivers MUST fail closed on any unknown critical entry.

schema.description: Schema profile ids this event depends on.

reducer.description: Reducer profile id this event depends on.

features.description: Features this event requires; receiver MUST fail closed if any is unknown.

critical_extensions.description: Critical extension declarations; each entry MUST have id, scope, fail_closed=true.

allOf.$comment: Known active non-reducer event kinds MUST NOT carry preconditions/effects/anchor_ref.
Known active reducer-input event kinds MUST carry preconditions/effects/anchor_ref. Unknown extension kinds must declare their own critical extension requirements and are not matched by this branch.

Conflict-recovery event detection: any precondition with op=head_in implies conflict recovery semantics. When triggered, refs[] MUST contain BOTH a state_witness and an inclusion_proof (event-auth-state-resolution.md §8.1). Schema-level enforcement; reducer-level verify re-checks.
MUST contain at least one state_witness ref
MUST contain at least one inclusion_proof ref

Reject historical top-level legacy field names. additionalProperties=true at root permits profile/extension top-level fields (forward extensibility), but these specific names from earlier drafts MUST NOT appear — type/auth_refs/target_ref/operation_id are migrated to kind / refs[role=authorized_by] / payload.* fields / SDK-internal id (see operations-sync.md §5).

anyOf.$comment: dropped legacy field — replaces auth_refs with refs[role=authorized_by]

kind.description: add/remove → or-set; set → mv-register/cas-register/lww-register; transition → fsm; inc/dec → counter; append → ordered-log; insert/delete → rga (rga + lww-register require cx.profile.collaborative_text.v1).

element_id.description: RGA element id, format: "<issuer-did>:<seq>". Required for insert/delete ops on rga lattice cells.

predecessor.description: RGA insert: predecessor element id, or the literal "head" for list start.

role.description: Common roles include authorized_by, attestation, parent_event, after, audit_pair, recovery_capability, state_witness, inclusion_proof. audit_pair links a privacy-sensitive business event to its cx.audit.accessed record in the same Anchor batch; state_witness/inclusion_proof are critical for conflict-recovery events; see event-auth-state-resolution.md §8.1.

proof.description: Optional inline proof material. Used for inclusion_proof role: carries the Merkle audit path defined by event-auth-state-resolution.md §4.2 that proves a leaf belongs to a witness state_root. May be omitted when id alone is a content-addressed reference to a separately stored proof object.

kind.description: detached_jws = actor / device / service signature over canonical event bytes (excluding only proofs and unsigned; hlc IS covered as advisory signed metadata). Ordering authority signatures are carried by Anchor.

from_space_id.description: Source List Space (optional; reducer infers from current active edge if omitted).

target_space_id.description: Target List Space after move. This is the ONLY payload-level field for the destination; the reducer compiles it into the cas-register cell value as 'list_space_id' on the cell at cx:cell:cx.component.flow.position.v1:<board_space_id>:<flow_id>. Writers MUST NOT put 'list_space_id' directly on the cx.flow.move payload (additionalProperties=false enforces this) — there is exactly one destination input field on the wire.

flow_watch_set_payload.description: Payload for cx.flow.watch.set. Writes the (flow_id, actor_did) watch cell. The new cell value is computed from payload.level + payload.level_public: when level is null the effect is set null (clear, equivalent to mentions_only); when level is a string the effect is set { level, level_public? }. Reducer invariants: (1) actor_did MUST equal envelope.actor_id unless writer holds cx.flow.watch.manage_others; (2) when actor_did != envelope.actor_id (manage_others write), level MUST be one of {mentions_only, participating, all} and level_public MUST be omitted or false — writing muted or level_public=true on behalf of another actor MUST failed_precondition; (3) manage_others writes MUST carry refs[role=audit_pair] to a same-batch cx.audit.accessed event whose payload access_kind=watch_manage_others identifies writer / target / cell / before-after heads. See models/flow-and-message.md §8.4.

level.description: Watch level. Required. null clears the cell (equivalent to mentions_only / no record); in that case level_public MUST be omitted.

level_public.description: Opt-in publication of the level value to non-self projection consumers. Default false. muted MUST NOT be exposed even with level_public=true. MUST be omitted when level is null.

expected_value.description: Compiles to cas-register head_eq precondition. Whole-value compare against the cell pre-state: either null (assert no prior record) or { level, level_public? } matching the prior cell value exactly. Omit to disable CAS guard (last-write-wins within causal order).

allOf.description: level_public MUST be omitted when level is null (clearing a cell does not carry a public-level setting).
